verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, turn your face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal. Prophesy against him
and say, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: Look, I am against you, Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.

I will turn you around, put hooks in your jaws, and drag you out with your whole army, your horses and riders, all fully armed, a huge crowd carrying large and small shields, all of them armed with swords.
Persia, Cush, and Put will be with them, all with shields and helmets.
Gomer will come with all its troops, and Beth Togarmah from the far north with all its troops, many nations with you.
Get ready! Be prepared, you and all the crowds gathered around you. Take command of them.

After many days you will be called to arms. In future years you will invade a land that has recovered from war, whose people were gathered from many nations to the mountains of Israel, which had long been a wasteland. Its people were brought out from the nations, and now all of them live in safety.
You will advance like a storm. You will be like a cloud covering the land, you and all your troops and the many nations with you.
This is what the Lord GOD says: On that day thoughts will come into your mind, and you will make an evil plan.
You will say, "I will invade a land of unwalled villages. I will attack a peaceful people who live in safety, all of them living without walls, gates, or bars.
I will loot and plunder them. I will turn my hand against the rebuilt ruins and the people gathered from the nations, who now have livestock and goods and live at the center of the world."

Sheba and Dedan and the merchants of Tarshish with all its villages will ask you, "Have you come to loot? Have you gathered your crowds to plunder, to carry off silver and gold, to take away livestock and goods, and to seize great plunder?"'
So, son of man, prophesy and say to Gog, 'This is what the Lord GOD says: On that day, when my people Israel are living in safety, won't you notice it?
You will come from your place in the far north, you and many nations with you, all of them riding on horses, a huge crowd, a mighty army.

You will attack my people Israel like a cloud covering the land. In days to come, Gog, I will bring you against my land, so that the nations may know me when I show my holiness through you before their eyes.

This is what the Lord GOD says: Aren't you the one I spoke about in days gone by through my servants the prophets of Israel? At that time they prophesied for years that I would bring you against them.
On that day, when Gog attacks the land of Israel, my fury will flare up, says the Lord GOD.
In my jealousy and blazing fury I declare that on that day there will be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

The fish in the sea, the birds in the sky, the wild animals, every creature that crawls on the ground, and all the people on the face of the earth will tremble before me. The mountains will be overturned, the cliffs will crumble, and every wall will fall to the ground.
I will call for a sword against Gog on all my mountains, says the Lord GOD. Every man's sword will be turned against his brother.
I will judge him with disease and bloodshed. I will pour down torrents of rain, hailstones, burning fire, and sulfur on him, his troops, and the many nations with him.
In this way I will show my greatness and my holiness, and I will make myself known in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.'"
